integrations.prompt: While requirement-analysis runs: load the jev skill and use locate to find the code each requirement touches before reading files in full.
While execute-task runs: load the jev skill; locate code before reading whole files, and locate failures in saved command output.
While verify-task runs: load the jev skill; pre-screen DONE WHEN with check and the scope with classify change_scope, then confirm each lead at its cited lines.
During pr-review: load the jev skill; map acceptance criteria with check and scan the diff with classify change_risk, confirming each citation before reporting.
While address-feedback filters comments: load the jev skill; pre-sort them with classify review_comment and test already-addressed ones with check - the keep bar and the user gate decide.
While debug runs Phase 1: load the jev skill; locate root-cause lines in saved logs and classify them with the failure_kind preset.
